title: AgentsMessage
description: agents.message@1 (0.434.0; the owner, 2026-11-14: "resume sessions or swap models with ease"): the body of POST /runs/{id}/messages on every product's Run API and the Frame (openvibe-sdk/agents/api), answered 201 with the agents.step@1 it made. TEXT is the person's words for the run's next turn. USE swaps what runs that turn and every turn after it, in the same run and the same thread: another MODEL (agents.run@1's model shape, any of Exchange's or the person's own), another HARNESS (a coding harness by its id, for a code run), another EFFORT. The thread carries over whole, so nothing is restated; a product that cannot run the asked model or harness answers 409 agents.use_unavailable and changes nothing. A run that had ended takes the message as a resume: it runs again from its last step (status running), unless its product refuses with 409 agents.run_closed. Starting a new run that continues this one elsewhere is agents.run-start@1 with LINEAGE (fork, handoff, regenerate).

items.description: A file that goes with a message or a start: by its OpenVibe.Media id, or by an https address.

url.description: An https address the reader may fetch.

alt.description: What a picture shows, in words.

use.description: What runs from this turn on. Absent: the run keeps what it had.

model.description: The model that runs it, as the picker chose it (frame.choices@1's choice, with the name a person reads). EFFORT is the reasoning effort where the model has one.

source.description: openvibe: Exchange's directory, paid in credits. keys: the person's own key. machines: a model on the person's own computer (Link). plans: a signed-in plan through a harness.

harness.description: A coding harness by its id (claude-code, codex, opencode, openvibe, …): a code run hands its thread to it.
